The Mode 0 VOVP_RISING is 4.3 to 4.7 V. The internal D+ and D- range is at most VREF + 0.3 V (SLLSEY0A, April 2017, revised July 2017, SHA-256 066e20714b1c164e6c0f965c4870c9ea3a7a1ebb21b06a01cd9244e6ed11bfc6, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd2s701-q1.pdf, read 2026-09-29T01:06:58Z). A lower VREF brings the minimum threshold and the internal-pin limit below the 3.3 V full-speed level, so no setting passes both V12 and USB signalling. It covers D+ and D- only, so it also fails 'lines covered' (5 lines, V13). TPD2S703-Q1 shares the OVP design (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd2s703-q1.pdf, read 01:06:59Z)
